ducale-scala-doro.title: Scala d'Oro
ducale-scala-doro.artist: Jacopo Sansovino (design); Alessandro Vittoria (stucco); Giambattista Franco (frescoes)
ducale-scala-doro.location: Palazzo Ducale, Scala d'Oro, ceremonial stair leading to the upper institutional rooms and Atrio Quadrato
ducale-scala-doro.description: Actual stair interior with gilded white-stucco vault, fresco panels and stone steps.
ducale-scala-doro.rights: Photo: Wknight94; CC BY-SA 3.0; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/ . Source and attribution: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Scala_d'Oro_(Doge's_Palace).jpg . Download unchanged.

ducale-collegio-justice-peace.title: Venice Enthroned with Justice and Peace
ducale-collegio-justice-peace.location: Palazzo Ducale, Sala del Collegio, ceiling
ducale-collegio-justice-peace.description: Ceiling canvas: crowned Venice enthroned at upper right, Justice with sword and scales, Peace with olive branch, and lion below.
ducale-collegio-justice-peace.rights: Photo: Didier Descouens; CC BY-SA 4.0; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ . Source and attribution: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Paolo_Veronese_-_Venezia_in_trono_onorata_dalla_Giustizia_e_la_Pace_-_Palazzo_Ducale.jpg . Download unchanged. The source page additionally carries the photographer's no-Facebook notice.

ducale-senato-triumph-venice.title: Triumph of Venice
ducale-senato-triumph-venice.artist: Jacopo Tintoretto, with assistance from Domenico Robusti
ducale-senato-triumph-venice.location: Palazzo Ducale, Sala del Senato, central ceiling canvas
ducale-senato-triumph-venice.description: Tall framed ceiling painting: Venice seated above an ascending assembly of mythological sea figures.
ducale-senato-triumph-venice.rights: Image supplied by Web Gallery of Art (Emil Kren and Daniel Marx); no open image licence verified; publication permission not established.

ducale-apotheosis-venice.title: Apotheosis of Venice
ducale-apotheosis-venice.location: Palazzo Ducale, Sala del Maggior Consiglio, ceiling
ducale-apotheosis-venice.description: Large oval ceiling canvas in its gilt frame: Venice crowned above balconies, spectators and horsemen.
ducale-apotheosis-venice.rights: Image supplied by Web Gallery of Art (Emil Kren and Daniel Marx); no open image licence verified; publication permission not established.

ducale-porta-della-carta.title: Porta della Carta
ducale-porta-della-carta.location: Palazzo Ducale, monumental portal between the palace and Basilica di San Marco, facing the Piazzetta
ducale-porta-della-carta.description: Gothic portal stonework with pinnacles, tracery, roundel and kneeling doge before the winged lion; lower doorway partly outside the photograph.
ducale-porta-della-carta.rights: Photo: Jean-Pol GRANDMONT; CC BY 4.0; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . Source and attribution: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:0_Venise,_Porta_della_Carta_du_Palais_des_Doges(2).JPG . Download unchanged.

ducale-bocca-di-leone.title: Bocca di Leone: Secret Denunciation Letterbox
ducale-bocca-di-leone.date: Individual carving undated in the museum guide; this letterbox type is documented from the late 16th century
ducale-bocca-di-leone.description: Stone mask with mouth slot above the inscription DENONTIE SECRETE, concerning concealment of revenues from offices and benefices.
ducale-bocca-di-leone.rights: Photo: Architas; CC BY-SA 4.0; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ . Source and attribution: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bocca_di_Leone_in_the_Doge's_Palace_(Venice).jpg . Download unchanged.

accademia-san-giobbe-altarpiece.title: San Giobbe Altarpiece
accademia-san-giobbe-altarpiece.date: 1478 to the late 1480s (dating debated in the museum entry)
accademia-san-giobbe-altarpiece.location: Gallerie dell'Accademia, Sala II; museum entry marks the work under restoration
accademia-san-giobbe-altarpiece.description: Catalogue 38. Madonna and Child enthroned beneath a vaulted apse, six saints and three musician angels; full surviving shaped panel.
accademia-san-giobbe-altarpiece.rights: Gallerie dell'Accademia / Ministero della Cultura; no open image licence stated; publication permission not established. Image requests: https://www.gallerieaccademia.it/collezioni/richiesta-uso-immagini/

accademia-saint-george.title: Saint George
accademia-saint-george.description: Catalogue 588. Standing armoured saint within a fictive marble frame, fruit garland above and dead dragon below.
accademia-saint-george.rights: Gallerie dell'Accademia / Ministero della Cultura; no open image licence stated; publication permission not established. Image requests: https://www.gallerieaccademia.it/collezioni/richiesta-uso-immagini/

accademia-carpaccio-presentation-jesus.title: Presentation of Jesus in the Temple
accademia-carpaccio-presentation-jesus.location: Gallerie dell'Accademia, Sala II; formerly the third altar on the right in San Giobbe
accademia-carpaccio-presentation-jesus.description: Catalogue 44. Full altarpiece: Mary holding the infant opposite Simeon in a gold-mosaic apse, three musician angels at the base. Corrects the requested Presentation of the Virgin title.
accademia-carpaccio-presentation-jesus.rights: Gallerie dell'Accademia / Ministero della Cultura; no open image licence stated; publication permission not established. Image requests: https://www.gallerieaccademia.it/collezioni/richiesta-uso-immagini/

accademia-titian-pieta.title: Pieta
accademia-titian-pieta.artist: Titian (Tiziano Vecellio), completed by Palma Giovane
accademia-titian-pieta.description: Catalogue 400. Mary supports the dead Christ before a rusticated architectural niche; Magdalene gestures at left and an elderly kneeling man is at right.
accademia-titian-pieta.rights: Gallerie dell'Accademia / Ministero della Cultura; no open image licence stated; publication permission not established. Image requests: https://www.gallerieaccademia.it/collezioni/richiesta-uso-immagini/

accademia-miracle-slave.title: Saint Mark Freeing a Slave (Miracle of the Slave)
accademia-miracle-slave.description: Catalogue 42. Saint Mark descends headfirst above the naked slave lying amid a crowd. The Accademia canvas, not a Sforza Castle object.
accademia-miracle-slave.rights: Gallerie dell'Accademia / Ministero della Cultura; no open image licence stated; publication permission not established. Image requests: https://www.gallerieaccademia.it/collezioni/richiesta-uso-immagini/

accademia-la-vecchia.title: La Vecchia (The Old Woman)
accademia-la-vecchia.description: Catalogue 272. Half-length elderly woman with a white cap and shawl, pointing to herself beside a paper inscribed COL TEMPO.
accademia-la-vecchia.rights: Gallerie dell'Accademia / Ministero della Cultura; no open image licence stated; publication permission not established. Image requests: https://www.gallerieaccademia.it/collezioni/richiesta-uso-immagini/

accademia-vitruvian-man.title: Vitruvian Man (Study of Human Proportions)
accademia-vitruvian-man.location: Gallerie dell'Accademia, Gabinetto dei Disegni e delle Stampe; work on paper, normally NOT permanently exhibited; museum entry marks it not on display
accademia-vitruvian-man.description: Catalogue 228. Original annotated sheet with two superimposed male poses inside a circle and square; image is the drawing, not a reconstruction.
accademia-vitruvian-man.rights: Gallerie dell'Accademia / Ministero della Cultura; no open image licence stated; publication permission not established. Image requests: https://www.gallerieaccademia.it/collezioni/richiesta-uso-immagini/

borghese-david.title: David
borghese-david.description: Inventory LXXVII. Marble David twisting with a sling, poised to throw; not the Caravaggio painting.
borghese-david.rights: Galleria Borghese / Ministero della Cultura; no open image licence stated; publication permission not established. Image-use information: https://galleriaborghese.cultura.gov.it/info/foto-e-video/

borghese-pauline-bonaparte.title: Pauline Borghese Bonaparte as Venus Victorious
borghese-pauline-bonaparte.description: Inventory LIV. Pauline reclining on a carved couch, holding the apple of Venus; original Borghese marble.
borghese-pauline-bonaparte.rights: Galleria Borghese / Ministero della Cultura; no open image licence stated; publication permission not established. Image-use information: https://galleriaborghese.cultura.gov.it/info/foto-e-video/

borghese-aeneas-anchises-ascanius.title: Aeneas, Anchises and Ascanius
borghese-aeneas-anchises-ascanius.location: Sala 6 - Sala di Enea e Anchise
borghese-aeneas-anchises-ascanius.description: Inventory CLXXXII. Marble three-generation group: Aeneas carries Anchises, with the child Ascanius at his legs.
borghese-aeneas-anchises-ascanius.rights: Galleria Borghese / Ministero della Cultura; no open image licence stated; publication permission not established. Image-use information: https://galleriaborghese.cultura.gov.it/info/foto-e-video/

borghese-deposition-baglioni.title: Deposition (Baglioni Entombment)
borghese-deposition-baglioni.description: Inventory 369. Central Baglioni panel showing bearers carrying the dead Christ toward the tomb; not the dispersed predella panels.
borghese-deposition-baglioni.rights: Galleria Borghese / Ministero della Cultura; no open image licence stated; publication permission not established. Image-use information: https://galleriaborghese.cultura.gov.it/info/foto-e-video/

borghese-sacred-profane-love.title: Sacred and Profane Love
borghese-sacred-profane-love.description: Inventory 147. Clothed and nude women beside a sculpted basin, with Cupid leaning between them and a landscape beyond.
borghese-sacred-profane-love.rights: Galleria Borghese / Ministero della Cultura; no open image licence stated; publication permission not established. Image-use information: https://galleriaborghese.cultura.gov.it/info/foto-e-video/

borghese-danae.title: Danae
borghese-danae.description: Inventory 125. Danae reclines on a bed under a golden cloud, with winged Eros beside her and two small figures below.
borghese-danae.rights: Galleria Borghese / Ministero della Cultura; no open image licence stated; publication permission not established. Image-use information: https://galleriaborghese.cultura.gov.it/info/foto-e-video/

borghese-melissa.title: Melissa
borghese-melissa.artist: Dosso Dossi (Giovanni di Niccolo de Luteri)
borghese-melissa.location: Deposito (storage), as listed in the current museum catalogue; permanent-gallery display not claimed
borghese-melissa.description: Inventory 217. Seated sorceress in a wooded landscape, with book, torch and magical objects.
borghese-melissa.rights: Galleria Borghese / Ministero della Cultura; no open image licence stated; publication permission not established. Image-use information: https://galleriaborghese.cultura.gov.it/info/foto-e-video/

borghese-truth.title: Truth (Allegory of Truth)
borghese-truth.location: Sala 6 - Sala di Enea e Anchise
borghese-truth.description: Inventory CCLXXVIII. Seated marble female allegory with sun disc, raised drapery and globe underfoot; the completed Truth figure, not a completed Truth-and-Time group.
borghese-truth.rights: Galleria Borghese / Ministero della Cultura; no open image licence stated; publication permission not established. Image-use information: https://galleriaborghese.cultura.gov.it/info/foto-e-video/

borghese-spinario.title: Boy Removing a Thorn (Spinario / Cavaspina)
borghese-spinario.description: Inventory CLXXVI. Borghese marble copy with seated boy removing a thorn, fig leaf and rough rock support. Early modern work, not the ancient Capitoline bronze.
borghese-spinario.rights: Galleria Borghese / Ministero della Cultura; no open image licence stated; publication permission not established. Image-use information: https://galleriaborghese.cultura.gov.it/info/foto-e-video/

borghese-sick-bacchus.title: Sick Bacchus (Self-Portrait as Bacchus)
borghese-sick-bacchus.location: Sala 8 - Sala del Sileno, ground floor (pianterreno)
borghese-sick-bacchus.description: Inventory 534. Pale half-length Bacchus with ivy crown, turned shoulder and grapes held to his chest; fruit on the stone slab. Matches the object in existing borghese-03.jpg.
borghese-sick-bacchus.rights: Galleria Borghese / Ministero della Cultura; no open image licence stated; publication permission not established. Image-use information: https://galleriaborghese.cultura.gov.it/info/foto-e-video/

borghese-boy-basket-fruit.title: Boy with a Basket of Fruit
borghese-boy-basket-fruit.location: Sala 8 - Sala del Sileno, ground floor (pianterreno)
borghese-boy-basket-fruit.description: Inventory 136. Young man with exposed right shoulder holding a large basket of fruit against his chest; not the isolated Ambrosiana Basket of Fruit.
borghese-boy-basket-fruit.rights: Galleria Borghese / Ministero della Cultura; no open image licence stated; publication permission not established. Image-use information: https://galleriaborghese.cultura.gov.it/info/foto-e-video/

borghese-david-head-goliath.title: David with the Head of Goliath
borghese-david-head-goliath.location: Sala 8 - Sala del Sileno, ground floor (pianterreno)
borghese-david-head-goliath.description: Inventory 455. Youth holds a sword diagonally and extends the severed head of Goliath at right; Borghese version.
borghese-david-head-goliath.rights: Galleria Borghese / Ministero della Cultura; no open image licence stated; publication permission not established. Image-use information: https://galleriaborghese.cultura.gov.it/info/foto-e-video/

borghese-madonna-palafrenieri.title: Madonna dei Palafrenieri (Madonna and Child with Saint Anne)
borghese-madonna-palafrenieri.location: Sala 8 - Sala del Sileno, ground floor (pianterreno)
borghese-madonna-palafrenieri.description: Inventory 110. Mary and the standing child crush a serpent while Saint Anne watches at right; vertical altarpiece.
borghese-madonna-palafrenieri.rights: Galleria Borghese / Ministero della Cultura; no open image licence stated; publication permission not established. Image-use information: https://galleriaborghese.cultura.gov.it/info/foto-e-video/

borghese-saint-jerome-writing.title: Saint Jerome Writing
borghese-saint-jerome-writing.location: Sala 8 - Sala del Sileno, ground floor (pianterreno)
borghese-saint-jerome-writing.description: Inventory 056. Horizontal composition: elderly Jerome in red leans over a book with an extended writing arm and skull at left; Borghese version, not the Malta canvas.
borghese-saint-jerome-writing.rights: Galleria Borghese / Ministero della Cultura; no open image licence stated; publication permission not established. Image-use information: https://galleriaborghese.cultura.gov.it/info/foto-e-video/

borghese-saint-john-baptist.title: Saint John the Baptist
borghese-saint-john-baptist.location: Sala 8 - Sala del Sileno, ground floor (pianterreno)
borghese-saint-john-baptist.description: Inventory 267. Young seated nude John with red drapery, slender reed cross and ram at left; the Borghese painting, not a different reclining version.
borghese-saint-john-baptist.rights: Galleria Borghese / Ministero della Cultura; no open image licence stated; publication permission not established. Image-use information: https://galleriaborghese.cultura.gov.it/info/foto-e-video/

borghese-lady-unicorn.title: Lady with a Unicorn
borghese-lady-unicorn.date: c. 1506-1509; museum catalogue also discusses a proposed 1504-1505 dating
borghese-lady-unicorn.description: Inventory 371. Blond young woman with pendant and red sleeves holding a small unicorn, framed by two columns and distant landscape; the restored Borghese portrait.
borghese-lady-unicorn.rights: Galleria Borghese / Ministero della Cultura; no open image licence stated; publication permission not established. Image-use information: https://galleriaborghese.cultura.gov.it/info/foto-e-video/

sforza-sala-delle-asse.title: Sala delle Asse: Surviving Monochrome Decoration
sforza-sala-delle-asse.location: Museo d'Arte Antica, Sala VIII (Sala delle Asse), ground floor of the Corte Ducale; restoration context
sforza-sala-delle-asse.description: Photograph of the surviving Monocromo fragment: roots and rocky forms on visibly aged, cracked plaster. Actual decoration, not projection, digital rendering or hypothetical restored ceiling.
sforza-sala-delle-asse.rights: Photo: Hoclab; CC BY-SA 4.0; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ . Source and attribution: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sala_delle_Asse_-_dettaglio_monocromo.jpg . Download unchanged.

sforza-trivulzio-madonna.title: Trivulzio Madonna (Madonna in Glory with Saints)
sforza-trivulzio-madonna.location: Pinacoteca del Castello Sforzesco collection, Milan; current numbered gallery not asserted
sforza-trivulzio-madonna.description: Madonna and Child in a cherub mandorla beneath foliage, with Saints John the Baptist, Gregory, Benedict and Jerome; Mantegna's Trivulzio altarpiece, not a similarly named Lippi painting.
sforza-trivulzio-madonna.rights: Comune di Milano - Civiche Raccolte Artistiche, Castello Sforzesco, Milano (museum-supplied Google Arts & Culture image); no open licence stated; publication permission not established.

sforza-bramantino-argo.title: Argo (Argus)
sforza-bramantino-argo.artist: Bramantino (Bartolomeo Suardi), attribution in the national/regional catalogue
sforza-bramantino-argo.location: Sala del Tesoro, Rocchetta, Castello Sforzesco
sforza-bramantino-argo.description: Surviving fresco of a monumental standing guardian in illusionistic architecture with coloured roundels and peacocks; inserted vault corbel interrupts the head. Image source retains an older Bramante attribution; metadata follows the national catalogue.
sforza-bramantino-argo.rights: Image supplied by Web Gallery of Art (Emil Kren and Daniel Marx); no open image licence verified; publication permission not established.

correr-orpheus.title: Orpheus
correr-orpheus.description: Orpheus standing with a hand raised to his forehead, lyre against the tree-stump support; Museo Correr original sculpture.
correr-orpheus.rights: Photo: Didier Descouens; CC BY-SA 4.0; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ . Source and attribution: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:(Venice)_Orfeo_by_Antonio_Canova_-_Correr_Museum_Cl._XXV_n._1072.jpg . Download unchanged. The source page additionally carries the photographer's no-Facebook notice.

correr-eurydice.title: Eurydice
correr-eurydice.description: Eurydice with tilted head and drapery, pulled by a hand emerging from flames beside her; Museo Correr companion to Orpheus.
correr-eurydice.rights: Photo: Didier Descouens; CC BY-SA 4.0; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ . Source and attribution: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:(Venice)_Eurydice_by_Antonio_Canova_-_Museo_Correr.jpg . Download unchanged. The source page additionally carries the photographer's no-Facebook notice.

correr-daedalus-icarus.title: Daedalus and Icarus
correr-daedalus-icarus.description: Original Correr marble group: bearded Daedalus attaches a wing to the younger Icarus, with the connecting thread visible; not a plaster cast.
correr-daedalus-icarus.rights: Photo: Didier Descouens; CC BY-SA 4.0; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ . The source page additionally carries the photographer's no-Facebook notice.

correr-transfiguration.title: Transfiguration (Museo Correr version)
correr-transfiguration.location: Museo Correr painting collection; current numbered gallery not verified
correr-transfiguration.description: Early vertical Correr panel: Christ between Moses and Elijah above three apostles on rocky ground, with old attribution tablet below. Not Bellini's later Capodimonte version.
correr-transfiguration.rights: Image published by Museo e Real Bosco di Capodimonte / Ministero della Cultura for comparison with its own Bellini; the pictured panel belongs to Museo Correr. No open image licence stated; publication permission not established.

correr-two-venetian-ladies.title: Two Venetian Ladies
correr-two-venetian-ladies.location: Museo Correr painting collection; current numbered gallery not asserted
correr-two-venetian-ladies.description: Two seated women on a balustraded terrace with a page and animals; the Correr lower panel only, not the Getty hunting panel or a reconstructed combination.
correr-two-venetian-ladies.rights: Fondazione Musei Civici di Venezia (MUVE); no open image licence stated on the source page; publication permission not established.
